runs.t: Infinite Facade® offers a highly customizable, prefabricated building envelope solution that streamlines design and construction. With customizable aesthetics, accommodating full-height windows, and a single-source approach, it reduces risk while delivering a high-performance facade with architectural freedom.
Infinite Facade® combines precast, glazing and weather barrier into one panelized envelope, designed, manufactured and installed by a single team.
Panels arrive on site finished and sealed, so the building closes in weeks earlier, with fewer trades on the wall and one warranty for the whole envelope.
Factory-applied under controlled conditions for a continuous, inspected barrier across every panel.
Factory-applied under controlled conditions for a continuous, inspected barrier across every panel.
Factory-applied under controlled conditions for a continuous, inspected barrier across every panel.
Punched window openings surrounded by your choice of opaque finishes. The most economical configuration for projects prioritizing budget certainty.
Punched openings align with the top of the panel — minimizing horizontal joints and providing approximately 6" of additional vision glass from the interior.
Eliminates sealant joints at the floor line — providing full height, continuous exterior glass. The premium configuration for the most demanding architectural expressions.

In addition to the wide variety of colors and textures available in traditional precast, other materials can be cast into the exterior veneer — brick, terracotta, and stone. Form liners allow an endless number of geometric patterns and reveals.

Infinite Facade® is a standardized panel system that allows design teams to focus on aesthetics. It redefines how owners and design teams approach the facade system — without the coordination risk of traditional multi-trade delivery.
Infinite Facade® is designed and tested to meet or exceed industry performance standards — giving your design team the data needed for specifications and energy compliance.
Performance tests passed across air infiltration, water penetration, structural loading, thermal performance and seismic movement.
Download the Infinite Facade® Testing Overview
Less cement than traditional concrete systems
Available finishes, including textures, colors, glazing and metal panel
Point of contact through design, occupancy and warranty

Infinite Facade® supports a wide range of green building certification goals. Up to 4" of factory-installed HFO spray-foam insulation meets demanding energy code requirements — including CA Title 24 and WSEC.
Reduces heating energy ~30% vs. typical construction assemblies
GWP reduced by 60%+ vs. traditional curtain wall systems
EPD published — verified third-party environmental data for LEED

Extremely durable with flexibility in shapes, finishes, and embedded materials.
Lightweight, sculptural panels ideal for high seismic zones and complex geometries.
Factory-installed glazing systems integrated directly into the Infinite Facade® frame.
100+ standard colors, textures, form liners, and embedded materials for any design vision.
Our envelope specialists engage early — from schematic design through installation — with single-source accountability from contract through warranty.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
